simple.meaning: to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh)

simple.summary: כָּשָׂה (kâsâh) means to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh) First listed occurrence: Deut 32 15.

definitions.short: to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh)
definitions.full: H3780. kasah [ כָּשָׂה ] verb be sated, gorged with food (compare Arabic be filled with food ; Assyrian kissatum, sustenance, provender , food , Zephnpf BAS i. 503 ); — only Qal Perfect 2masculine singular כָּשִׂיתָ עָבִיתָ שָׁמַנְתָּ Deut 32:15 thou grewest fat, becamest thick, wast gorged ! figurative of Israel as fat beast (compare Dr). כֻּשִׁית כֻּשִׁיִּים see כּוּשִׁי .
